notes: Keeps the simplified v2.11.34 Site-wide/H&S-or-real-Department ownership model and expands Monthly First Aid into First Aid Equipment. Adds Eye Wash Station as a separate equipment/check type within First Aid, requires Department plus exact physical location, uses the Department First Aid responsible person by default with an optional equipment-specific member override, and provides editable HSE-based starter templates. New First Aid Boxes can load the HSE L74 low-hazard suggested contents; new Eye Wash Stations default to 2 x 500 ml sterile water or sterile 0.9% saline bottles (1 litre total) where mains tap water is not readily available. All checklist items/quantities remain editable to the site first-aid needs assessment. Supabase migrations through v2.11.35 are already applied.
